parsed.title: Emberdeep: The Locked Exit
parsed.design_notes: A lava cave on one screen. Three lava pits break the cave floor; each gap is 5 cells (within the 6-cell max). A ledge staircase on the left climbs 3 cells at a time to the key. The exit at the far right is sealed by a stone door pillar that runs from the ceiling block down to the floor, so the goal is unreachable until the key is taken. Two patrolling cave creatures and a ping-pong platform over the second lava pit provide medium pressure.

Land on the checkpoint flag so you never lose your progress, and if you fall, bounce off the new spring and rocket right back up to the star!

parsed.title: Hop Along Hill
parsed.design_notes: A gentle left-to-right run on one screen. Four ground slabs separated by three 3-cell gaps (max safe gap is 6, so these are forgiving). Coin arcs float above each gap to teach the player to jump at the right moment. One slow patrolling enemy on the third slab and a single short spike strip in the last gap add mild challenge. Low 1-row platforms give optional height and bonus coins; everything is within the 3-cell jump height. No key or door in this intro level.

parsed.title: Spike Gauntlet Over the Void
parsed.design_notes: Three zones: a spiked starting ledge, a long bottomless pit crossed by ping-ponging platforms with two tiny spiked islands as rest points, and a spiked landing strip before the goal. All gaps are 6 cells or less and all climbs are at most 3 rows; falling into the pit (x=10..41) kills. No key needed.

parsed.title: The Watchtower Climb
parsed.design_notes: A vertical zig-zag tower: seven ledges alternate left and right, each exactly 3 rows above the previous one with 1-2 cell gaps, so every hop is within the 3-cell jump limit. Walking enemies patrol almost every ledge, forcing timed landings. Spikes punish a sloppy fall to the ground floor, and a side elevator on the right wall offers an optional coin detour. No key needed - pure climb.
